The '''battlesphere''' was a variant of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Core ship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Core Ship]], used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Skytop_B1s_talking.png|left|thumb|220x220px|[[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] inside Skytop Station]]
Unlike the [[Core ship/Legends|''Lucrehulk''-class Core Ship]], the battlesphere employed multiple reactors and was fitted with more extensive [[Hyperwave transceiver/Legends|hyperwave transceivers]].<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />

Its hangar facilities had enough room for several fighter squadrons. There was also a storage room for additional [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] parts. Outlying control stations and sensors spanned out from the central sphere. The hangar bay doors could be activated from a panel on one of these.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />

==History==
[[File:Skytop_station_destroyed.png|thumb|left|200px|Skytop Station is struck by internal explosions.]]
The [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] placed a battlesphere in the atmosphere on [[Ruusan 2/Legends|one]] of the moons of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]]. This [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]] served as an important listening post for the Separatists, enabling [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] to launch many successful campaigns by gaining knowledge about the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fleet positions through the station.<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />

[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] strike team infiltrated the station on a dual mission, to blow it up and to rescue [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who had been captured by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] scavenger [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]] and brought on-board. All [[Clone trooper/Legends|clones]] who participated in the mission, not counting the [[Clone trooper pilot|pilot]], were killed by Grievous, except for [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Denal/Legends|Denal]]<ref name="Duel of the Droids" />

With the assistance of his newly purchased [[EG-5 Jedi Hunter droid|EG droid]], [[EG-07]], Grievous later began drilling to the core of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] to uncover an ancient superweapon hidden under the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and placed a battlesphere similar to Skytop Station above Mustafar. The Jedi thus began an investigation into the matter, sending [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] to steal Separatist recognition codes from an archive in Grievous's castle on [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek's]] third [[Moon/Legends|moon]], which they used to infiltrate the Separatist-controlled [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Juma 9]], using the station's scanners to locate the superweapon on Mustafar. Meanwhile, Grievous had found the weapon and prepared to use the battlestation's superlasers to charge the weapon, so that it could fire and spread the deadly virus which would then destroy all life in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Having learned of Grievous's intentions, the Jedi dispatched Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano, [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] to prevent the battlestation's lasers from charging the weapon. With Grievous' deception revealed, [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] forgave the general as Grievous' plans had bought [[Kul Teska]] the time he had needed to complete his [[gravitic polarization beam]].<ref name="Republic Heroes">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] edition</ref>
